LanguageData.VGE_HostileWarcomputer.description: The tactical core of an orbital warplatform. This advanced supercomputer maintains active target locks and manages the platform's long-range artillery systems. It can be accessed and hacked to download flight data, scaling with progress on the currently selected Hellion-systems research project. Destroying or hacking the warcomputer will disable the platform entirely.
LanguageData.VGE_HostileWarcomputer.comps.3.text: You've discovered a hostile warcomputer running an orbital warplatform. Destroy it to disable all platform weaponry and obtain a reactor core.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravjumperEngine.label: enemy Hellion Fighter engine
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravjumperEngine.description: A compact engine designed for short-range jumps within a planet's atmosphere. The Hellion Fighter engine creates a brief, localized distortion in gravitational flow, allowing rapid vertical lift, but does not produce forward thrust. It cannot function far from a large gravity well, so it is useless for interplanetary travel.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources, including a reactor core.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravjumperEngine.comps.3.label: Hellion Fighter engine
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravjumperEngine.comps.3.text: You've discovered an enemy Hellion Fighter engine. Destroy it to obtain a reactor core and permanently disable the aircraft's ability to move.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravEngine.label: enemy Hellion engine
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravEngine.description: The pre-War heart of a Hellion. The Hellion engine generates lift by inverting and intensifying the effect of gravity in a field around itself. It can lift upward but does not produce forward thrust.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources, including a reactor core.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravEngine.comps.3.label: Hellion engine
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravEngine.comps.3.text: You've discovered an enemy Hellion engine. Destroy it to obtain a reactor core and permanently disable the aircraft's ability to move.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravhulkEngine.label: enemy Hellion Carrier engine
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravhulkEngine.description: The Hellion Carrier is a colossal aircraft class engineered to transport major settlements, orbital platforms, or mobile industrial cores across a planet. Its Hellion Carrier engine generates lift by inverting and intensifying gravity in a field around itself. It cannot function far from a large gravity well and is useless for interplanetary travel.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources, including a reactor core.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravhulkEngine.comps.3.label: Hellion Carrier engine
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravhulkEngine.comps.3.text: You've discovered an enemy Hellion Carrier engine. Destroy it to obtain a reactor core and permanently cripple the aircraft's mobility.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravlockTether.description: The gravlock tether is the central stabilization unit of an orbital station, anchoring it in a fixed position. A specialized conversion of the Hellion Carrier engine, this device generates a stabilized gravity field to maintain the station's orbital trajectory.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources, including a reactor core.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravlockTether.comps.3.text: You've discovered an enemy gravlock tether anchoring an orbital base in place. Destroy it to obtain a reactor core.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyPilotCockpit.description: An interface that allows launching and piloting a Hellion Fighter. It draws power directly from the Hellion Fighter engine.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyPilotConsole.description: An interface that allows launching and piloting a Hellion. It draws power directly from the Hellion engine.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyPilotBridge.description: An interface that allows launching and piloting a Hellion Carrier. It draws power directly from the Hellion Carrier engine.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyTargetingTerminal.description: An enemy control terminal responsible for calibrating nearby Hellion artillery turrets.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyTargetingConsole.description: A large enemy targeting console responsible for calibrating the reload sequence of nearby Hellion artillery pieces.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGaussGun.description: A small, single-barrel electromagnetic cannon that launches dense uranium slugs at extreme velocities. Designed for both local bombardment and medium-range engagements, it can also target other Hellions in orbit. It draws power directly from the Hellion engine and does not require a linked terminal.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyJavelinPod.description: A compact multi-tube missile platform that launches a volley of six guided astrofuel javelins. Intended for fast, hard-hitting strikes against exposed Hellions and unarmored surface forces, it draws power directly from the Hellion engine and does not require a linked terminal.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyAnticraftCaster.description: A medium Hellion-mounted energy weapon that fires short, razor-sharp bursts with surgical precision. Built to punch holes through critical systems, it trades sustained suppression for rapid strikes. It draws power directly from the Hellion engine and does not require a linked terminal.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyAnticraftBeam.description: A massive anti-aircraft beam weapon intended to destroy flying craft, but also capable of firing onto the surface from space. Aircraft using advanced signal jammers can delay its targeting.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be destroyed to yield valuable resources, including a reactor core.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyAnticraftBeam.comps.3.text: You've discovered an anti-aircraft beam. This powerful orbital weapon can annihilate any Hellion that challenges it. Destroy it to secure the airspace and obtain a reactor core.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyPointDefenseTurret.description: A specialized defensive turret built exclusively for Hellions. It intercepts explosive projectiles and incoming drop pods within its protective radius but cannot engage ground targets. Interception chance scales with the target's velocity.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemySignalJammer.description: An advanced signal jammer that disrupts local guidance signals, preventing the deployment of Hellions and drop pods in its immediate vicinity. This particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGaussCannon.description: A massive, single-barrel anti-aircraft cannon that uses powerful electromagnets to launch large metallic darts at extreme velocities. Aircraft equipped with advanced signal jammers can temporarily paralyze its targeting systems.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be destroyed to yield valuable resources, including a reactor core.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGaussCannon.comps.2.text: You've discovered a gauss cannon, a devastating piece of orbital artillery. Destroy it to eliminate the threat and obtain a reactor core.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGaussHowitzer.description: A triple-barrel electromagnetic artillery piece that fires dense uranium slugs at high velocity. Designed for local bombardment and long-range engagements, it can also target other Hellions in orbit. It draws power directly from the Hellion engine and does not require a linked terminal.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyJavelinLauncher.description: A heavy multi-tube missile platform that fires twelve long-range guided astrofuel javelins. Designed for saturation strikes against surface targets and enemy Hellions in orbit, it draws power directly from the Hellion engine and does not require a linked terminal.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyShieldGenerator.description: A shielding device that can protect a Hellion. It modulates the lift field to create a short-lived momentum-repulsor surface that blocks projectiles. Those inside can still shoot out. It must be charged before use.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyLargeShieldGenerator.descriptio: A large-scale shielding device that can protect a Hellion. It modulates the lift field to create a short-lived momentum-repulsor surface that blocks projectiles. Those inside can still shoot out. It must be charged before use.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemySmallThruster.description: An astrofuel thruster that increases the range and maximum size of the Hellion.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyLargeThruster.description: An advanced astrofuel thruster with a heat-resistant vacstone liner. It greatly increases the range and maximum size of the Hellion.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGiantThruster.description: A massive reinforced astrofuel thruster built with advanced alloys and ultra-dense vacstone plating. It massively increases the range and maximum size of the Hellion.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravFieldExtender.description: A pre-War device used to increase the size of a Hellion. It extends the area in which deck plating can be built and increases the amount the aircraft can support.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravFieldAmplifier.description: An advanced pre-War device that dramatically increases the size of a Hellion. It extends the area in which deck plating can be built and increases the amount the aircraft can support.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_AncientSignalJammer.description: An archaic broadcasting array emitting a high-frequency interference field that cripples long-range communications and disrupts Hellion navigational locks. As long as it is active, Hellion or shuttle launches from this area are impossible and comms consoles cannot be used. It contains a valuable reactor core.
LanguageData.VGE_AncientSignalJammer.comps.1.text: You've discovered an ancient signal jammer actively preventing aircraft from leaving the area. Destroy it to lift the lockdown and obtain a reactor core.
LanguageData.VGE_InfestedGravlockTether.description: A corrupted gravlock tether hollowed out and repurposed into a gigantic exoinsectoid hive. Integrated into the station's ventilation system, this pulsing structure continuously pumps larvae through the vents, spawning new insectoids throughout the station.\n\nDestroy the infested gravlock tether to obtain a reactor core.
LanguageData.VGE_InfestedGravlockTether.comps.3.text: You detect signs of the exoinsectoid mega-hive nearby. Destroy the infested gravlock tether to obtain a reactor core and stop the ongoing infestation.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravshipMinigunTurret.label: enemy Hellion minigun turret
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravshipMinigunTurret.descripti: A compact Hellion-mounted heavy automatic turret. Its multi-barrel mechanism unleashes sustained fire at high speed, shredding lightly armored targets at mid-range. It may explode when damaged.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_EnemyGravshipMinigun.label: Hellion minigun
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravshipAutocannonTurret.label: enemy Hellion autocannon turret
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravshipAutocannonTurret.descri: A compact Hellion-mounted automatic turret. Its large-caliber shells do heavy damage over significant ranges, but the barrel must be refurbished after heavy use. It cannot fire at close targets and may explode when damaged.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_EnemyGravshipAutocannon.label: Hellion autocannon
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravshipUraniumSlugTurret.label: enemy Hellion uranium slug turret
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravshipUraniumSlugTurret.descr: A compact Hellion-mounted armor-piercing turret. Its ultra-dense uranium shells can punch through heavy armor. It is more accurate at longer ranges and cannot fire at close targets. May explode when damaged.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and cannot be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_EnemyGravshipUraniumSlug.label: Hellion uranium slug gun
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyOxygenPump.description: A unit connected to the Hellion's life-support network. It keeps rooms heated and pressurized.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravshipLight_red.label: enemy Hellion light
